sentences.en: If you would, would you walk us through a typical day for you?
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，你能为我们介绍一下你典型的一天吗？

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》（Hidden Brain）。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆（Shankar Vedantam）。

sentences.en: Today, we're talking about finding meaning in our work.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们来谈谈如何在工作中寻找意义。

sentences.en: I generally come in at least 15 minutes late.
sentences.zh: 我通常至少会迟到15分钟。

sentences.en: I use the side door, that way Lumberg can't see me.
sentences.zh: 我走侧门，这样伦伯格（Lumberg）就看不见我了。

sentences.en: And after that, I just sort of space out for about an hour.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我大概会发呆一个小时左右。

sentences.en: But who?
sentences.zh: 但是谁呢？

sentences.en: Space out?
sentences.zh: 发呆？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I just stare at my desk.
sentences.zh: 我就盯着我的办公桌看。

sentences.en: But it looks like I'm working.
sentences.zh: 但看起来我好像在工作一样。

sentences.en: This clip from the movie Office Space describes what work feels like to many people.
sentences.zh: 电影《办公空间》（Office Space）里的这段片段描述了许多人对工作的感受。

sentences.en: Not the stuff of poetry.
sentences.zh: 这可不是什么诗情画意的东西。

sentences.en: But now, imagine something that feels more than just a job.
sentences.zh: 但现在，想象一下某种感觉不仅仅是一份工作的东西。

sentences.en: Something that feels like a calling.
sentences.zh: 某种感觉像是天职的东西。

sentences.en: What we learned is people who see their work as a calling are significantly more satisfied with their jobs.
sentences.zh: 我们了解到，那些将工作视为天职的人，对工作的满意度要高得多。

sentences.en: They're significantly more satisfied with their lives.
sentences.zh: 他们对生活的满意度也高得多。

sentences.en: They're more engaged in what it is that they're doing and tend to be better performers,
sentences.zh: 他们对自己所做的事情投入度更高，而且往往表现得更好，

sentences.en: regardless of what the work is.
sentences.zh: 无论工作内容是什么。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, a conversation with Amy Resnusky,
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》，我们将与艾米·雷斯努斯基（Amy Resnusky）进行对话，

sentences.en: Professor of Organizational Behavior at the Yale School of Management.
sentences.zh: 她是耶鲁大学管理学院的组织行为学教授。

sentences.en: Amy studies work and something that she calls job crafting.
sentences.zh: 艾米研究工作，以及她所称的“工作重塑”（job crafting）。

sentences.en: Job crafting can help you make the job that you have right now more meaningful and more satisfying.
sentences.zh: 工作重塑可以帮助你让你现在的工作变得更有意义、更令人满意。

sentences.en: Amy Resnusky, welcome to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 艾米·雷斯努斯基，欢迎来到《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我。

sentences.en: I was reading one of your papers recently, and I was struck by an excerpt that you had at the top.
sentences.zh: 我最近在读你的一篇论文，被你开头引用的一段摘录深深吸引了。

sentences.en: One came from a corporate securities lawyer, and one came from a taxidermiSt.
sentences.zh: 一段来自一位企业证券律师，另一段来自一位标本剥制师。

sentences.en: And I was struck by what the two of them said.
sentences.zh: 他们两人所说的话让我深受触动。

sentences.en: Can you tell me what they said?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我他们说了什么吗？

sentences.en: Amy Resnusky's lawyer was bemoaning the fact that his job as he saw it was,
sentences.zh: 艾米·雷斯努斯基的律师感叹道，在他看来，他的工作是，

sentences.en: I think his words were a deal with the devil, that he did the job not because he liked it,
sentences.zh: 我想他的原话是“与魔鬼做交易”，他做这份工作不是因为他喜欢，

sentences.en: but because it allowed him to stay geographically in an area that worked for his family and so on.
sentences.zh: 而是因为它让他能够留在地理位置上适合他家庭的地方，诸如此类。

sentences.en: And in contrast, the taxidermist was talking about the way in which the kind of work he did
sentences.zh: 相比之下，那位标本剥制师谈到了他所做的工作方式，

sentences.en: sometimes moved people to tears when they came and picked up the pieces that he had created for them,
sentences.zh: 有时当人们来取他为他们制作的作品时，会感动得热泪盈眶，

sentences.en: and how for him the feeling of satisfaction that comes from work that has that kind of impact
sentences.zh: 对他来说，那种能产生如此影响的工作所带来的满足感，

sentences.en: is one of the biggest things in his life.
sentences.zh: 是他生命中最重要的事情之一。

sentences.en: I have the paper in front of me.
sentences.zh: 我手头就有这篇论文。

sentences.en: The taxidermist said,
sentences.zh: 那位标本剥制师说，

sentences.en: I did a duck for a guy the other day, and when he came and picked it up,
sentences.zh: 前几天我为一个人做了一只鸭子，当他来取的时候，

sentences.en: he almost started crying because it looked so nice.
sentences.zh: 他差点哭了出来，因为它看起来太漂亮了。

sentences.en: He was just so happy, and that made me feel good that he thought I'd done a good job.
sentences.zh: 他非常高兴，这让我觉得很好，因为他认为我做得很好。

sentences.en: Self-satisfaction is a big deal in any job.
sentences.zh: 自我满足感在任何工作中都很重要。

sentences.en: It's a big deal in life.
sentences.zh: 在生活中也很重要。

sentences.en: And I was so moved by that comment because, of course,
sentences.zh: 我被那段评论深深打动了，因为当然，

sentences.en: if you just looked at those two jobs side by side,
sentences.zh: 如果你只是把这两份工作放在一起看，

sentences.en: you might assume that the corporate securities lawyer with a high-profile fancy job
sentences.zh: 你可能会认为那位拥有高调、体面工作的企业证券律师

sentences.en: is the person who's actually happier at work, but that's not often the case.
sentences.zh: 才是工作中更快乐的人，但事实往往并非如此。

sentences.en: That's not often the case, and in fact, a good amount of the research that I've done
sentences.zh: 事实往往并非如此，事实上，我所做的大量研究

sentences.en: has tried to look at how the experiences that people have in their work,
sentences.zh: 都试图观察人们在工作中的经历，

sentences.en: the ways in which they talk about it and come to think about its place in their lives
sentences.zh: 他们谈论工作的方式，以及他们如何看待工作在他们生活中的地位，

sentences.en: vary so much across the entire spectrum in ways that research hasn't necessarily recognized.
sentences.zh: 在整个范围内差异巨大，而这些差异是研究未必已经认识到的。

sentences.en: When you went into a hospital some years ago
sentences.zh: 几年前当你走进一家医院时，

sentences.en: and you looked at the people working as the cleaning staff at the hospital,
sentences.zh: 你观察了那些在医院做清洁工作的人，

sentences.en: you discovered something very interesting.
sentences.zh: 你发现了一些非常有趣的事情。

sentences.en: You found that they did not all think of their jobs the same way.
sentences.zh: 你发现他们并不是都以同样的方式看待自己的工作。

sentences.en: That's true, and our first clue about this was not necessarily in how they talked about the ways
sentences.zh: 没错，我们关于这一点的第一个线索并不一定在于他们谈论工作的方式，

sentences.en: that they thought about the job, but in how it was that they described the tasks of their job.
sentences.zh: 而在于他们如何描述自己的工作任务。

sentences.en: So on the one hand, we had this group of hospital cleaning staff members
sentences.zh: 一方面，我们有一组医院清洁人员，

sentences.en: who described the work as being not very high-skill,
sentences.zh: 他们描述这份工作技术含量不高，

sentences.en: and another group who described it in very different terms and said this was highly-skilled work
sentences.zh: 而另一组人则用非常不同的术语来描述它，说这是一项高技术工作，

sentences.en: where it would be very difficult to bring others in and have them take over the job.
sentences.zh: 如果让别人来接手这份工作会非常困难。

sentences.en: And in looking to see what were the differences between these two groups of cleaners,
sentences.zh: 在观察这两组清洁工之间的区别时，

sentences.en: we had no differences in the kind of shift that they worked,
sentences.zh: 我们发现他们在轮班类型上没有区别，

sentences.en: their tenure in the organization, the kind of units they worked on, and so on.
sentences.zh: 他们在组织中的任期、他们工作的部门等等也没有区别。

sentences.en: Instead, what was different was what they described as being
sentences.zh: 相反，不同之处在于他们所描述的

sentences.en: the kinds of things that they did during the daily course of the work.
sentences.zh: 他们在日常工作中做的事情。

sentences.en: So in the first group, the cleaners who described the work as being not particularly high-skilled,
sentences.zh: 所以第一组，那些认为工作技术含量不高的清洁工，

sentences.en: they very much hewed to the job description.
sentences.zh: 他们非常严格地遵守工作描述。

sentences.en: And the job description, while extensive, doesn't involve a lot of interaction,
sentences.zh: 而工作描述虽然详尽，却不涉及太多的互动，

sentences.en: in fact, any interaction, with patients, visitors, nurses, doctors, and so on.
sentences.zh: 事实上，与病人、访客、护士、医生等没有任何互动。

sentences.en: Presumably they were just swabbing floors, dusting, mopping, doing cleaning crew type stuff.
sentences.zh: 大概他们只是擦地板、除尘、拖地，做清洁工该做的事。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in the second group, they also talked about all of these kinds of things,
sentences.zh: 第二组人也谈到了所有这些事情，

sentences.en: but in addition talked about the kinds of things that they did on a regular basis
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，他们还谈到了他们定期为护士、医生、病人及病人家属所做的事情，

sentences.en: for and with nurses, doctors, patients, and patients' visitors.
sentences.zh: 以及与他们一起做的事情。

sentences.en: And we checked this multiple times, but this was not something that they were being asked to do.
sentences.zh: 我们多次核实了这一点，但这并不是要求他们做的事情。

sentences.en: Often these kinds of things were going beyond the notice of those who supervised them
sentences.zh: 通常这些事情是在他们主管的视线之外进行的，

sentences.en: in the hospital in which they worked.
sentences.zh: 在他们工作的医院里。

sentences.en: But for the cleaners who engaged in this, we ended up calling this job crafting.
sentences.zh: 但对于参与其中的清洁工，我们最终称之为“工作重塑”。

sentences.en: They were crafting the boundaries of their jobs in ways that we think made the work for them more meaningful.
sentences.zh: 他们以我们认为让工作对他们更有意义的方式重塑了工作的边界。

sentences.en: It was something that they very much undertook on their own.
sentences.zh: 这是他们完全自发进行的事情。

sentences.en: If I remember correctly, some of the people who found their work especially difficult
sentences.zh: 如果我没记错的话，一些觉得工作特别困难的人，

sentences.en: were in fact doing work that might be argued to be against the rules.
sentences.zh: 实际上做的工作可能被认为是违反规定的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So some of the things that the cleaning staff members in this part of our sample described doing
sentences.zh: 所以我们样本中这部分清洁人员描述的一些事情，

sentences.en: involved figuring out when would it be safe, for example, to give a patient a drink of water
sentences.zh: 包括弄清楚什么时候是安全的，例如，给病人喝水，

sentences.en: if they requested one, or when was it safe to help a patient to move, or things like this,
sentences.zh: 如果他们有要求的话，或者什么时候帮助病人移动是安全的，诸如此类，

sentences.en: which moves into the realm of patient care and could very well get them into trouble.
sentences.zh: 这进入了病人护理的领域，很可能会给他们带来麻烦。

sentences.en: But the cleaning staff members we studied had developed systems of figuring out
sentences.zh: 但我们研究的清洁人员已经建立了一套系统来判断

sentences.en: when was it safe to do these things, when was it okay to do these things,
sentences.zh: 什么时候做这些事情是安全的，什么时候是可以做的，

sentences.en: versus when would it be necessary to go and get a member of the medical staff.
sentences.zh: 以及什么时候有必要去叫医务人员。

sentences.en: You found one woman in particular who did something really interesting
sentences.zh: 你发现其中一位女性做了一件非常有趣的事情，

sentences.en: when it came to patients who were in a coma.
sentences.zh: 当涉及到昏迷的病人时。

sentences.en: Tell me what she did.

sentences.en: So this particular staff member worked in essentially a long-term rehabilitation floor
sentences.zh: 所以这位特定的工作人员基本上是在一个长期康复楼层工作，

sentences.en: where patients were unconscious or comatose and hopefully would be emerging from those states.
sentences.zh: 那里的病人处于无意识或昏迷状态，希望他们能从这些状态中恢复过来。

sentences.en: Most patient rooms have some kind of print or another.

sentences.en: And she would take those down on a regular basis and rearrange them and rehang them.

sentences.en: in her job description, she answered that it was not, which was quite striking.

sentences.en: And in asking more deeply about, well, why do this, talked about the hope that even though
